shortDescription: Create, Update or Delete a Queue on AOS-CX devices.

options.name: algorithm
options.description: Scheduling behavior of the queue, strict will service packets in queue before packets in lower numbered queues, dwrr, or Deficit Weighted Round Robin will apportion available bandwidth among all non-empty dwrr queues in relation to their weight, wfq, or Weighted Fair Queueing will apportion available bandwidth among all non-empty wfq queues in relation to their weight.

options.name: bandwidth
options.description: Bandwidth limit in kilobits per second to apply to egress traffic, if not specified, bandwidth is not limited per queue.

options.name: burst
options.description: burst size in kilobytes allowed per bandwidth-queue, if not specified the default 32KB will be applied.

options.name: gmb_percent
options.description: The Guaranteed Minimum Bandwidth as a percentage of line rate. This option is mutually exclusive with the no_gmb_percent option.

options.name: no_gmb_percent
options.description: Option to remove the Guaranteed Minimum Bandwidth. This option is mutually exclusive with the gmb_percent option.

options.name: qos_name
options.description: Name to identify a QoS configuration.

options.name: state
options.description: Create, update or delete the Queue.

options.name: weight
options.description: Weight value for a queue. Maximum number is hardware dependent.
